jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(F) inventory: Oxbow Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Orange East Supervisory Union (member towns: Bradford, Newbury). Operates PK-12.

board.post_note: Oxbow UUSD: six directors, residency allocated three representing Bradford and three representing Newbury, elected by the whole district electorate at the single district annual meeting (modified at-large, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) pattern).

sources.note: Oxbow UUSD Annual Meeting Minutes, April 28, 2026 (official; the district's own posted record, marked draft until approved): Article 5 elects "two school directors of said District, one (1) to represent the Town of Bradford for a three-year term to expire 2029 and one (1) to represent the Town of Newbury for a three-year term to expire 2029" -- Tim Ross (Newbury) and Angela Colbeth (Bradford) elected unanimously by voice vote. The board is six directors (three representing Bradford, three Newbury) elected by the whole district electorate at the single annual meeting -- modified at-large.

Orange East SU Oxbow board page (official): five members with towns and terms -- Ballou (Bradford) 2024-2027, Cottrell (Newbury) 2024-2027, Corti (Newbury, Chair) 2025-2028, Hatch (Bradford) 2025-2028, Colbeth (Bradford) 2026-2029. All six directors (incl. Tim Ross) signed the district's June 16, 2026 revote warning. The page OMITS Tim Ross (Newbury, elected April 28, 2026 to expire 2029 per the annual meeting minutes); the omission reads as a stale page, disclosed on his membership.
